caption:
Most healing studies you hear about were done on rats 🔬 Only about one in ten treatments that work in animals go on to succeed in humans — different metabolism, different healing speed, different lifespan.

When you read a result, check which species it came from. Every entry on pepsafe.info says: animals, humans, or neither.
